description: Sabaragamuwa  Provincial Council   -  By-Laws of  Ayagama   Pradeshiya  Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the approval and enactment of a by-law regulating dangerous and unpleasant businesses within the Ayagama Pradeshiya Sabha area. It establishes regulatory frameworks, compliance requirements, and enforcement procedures under the Pradeshiya Sabha Act, making it a Legal/Regulatory gazette. The content does not involve government personnel changes, structural reorganizations, or any of the other specialized categories like land, commercial, or public service matters.
